verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Postman documents an official MCP server at postman.com/postman-mcp-server, which is the product itself exposing an MCP endpoint for agents to connect to. The MCP Generator and the Fabric gateway MCP registration are adjacent features, not the official server, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: setup and auth details, the tool or capability list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
